source_info.notes: HPSC data are published by operator decision without confirmed written permission; HPSC terms require prior permission. Archive reuse rights have not been verified. ECDC annual data are attributed separately.

sources.label: Ireland HPSC Notifiable Disease Weekly Hub
sources.description: HPSC weekly notification data. Published by operator decision; written reuse permission has not been confirmed. HPSC terms require prior permission.
sources.description_zh: 爱尔兰 HPSC 每周法定传染病数据。根据网站运营者决定公开；尚未确认取得书面再利用许可，HPSC 条款要求事先取得许可。
sources.description_fr: Données hebdomadaires du HPSC publiées sur décision de l’exploitant ; l’autorisation écrite de réutilisation n’a pas été confirmée et les conditions du HPSC exigent une autorisation préalable.

sources.label: Ireland HPSC Weekly Report Archive
sources.description: Sparse historical weekly reports; missing reports are not zero. Published by operator decision; archive reuse rights have not been verified.
sources.description_zh: 不连续的历史周报；缺失报告不代表零。根据网站运营者决定公开，档案再利用权利尚未核实。
sources.description_fr: Rapports hebdomadaires historiques incomplets ; une absence ne signifie pas zéro. Publiés sur décision de l’exploitant ; les droits de réutilisation des archives n’ont pas été vérifiés.

sources.label: Ireland HPSC Annual Infectious Disease Statistics
sources.description: HPSC historical annual statistics, published by operator decision; written reuse permission has not been confirmed.
sources.description_zh: 爱尔兰 HPSC 历年年度统计，根据网站运营者决定公开；尚未确认取得书面再利用许可。
sources.description_fr: Statistiques annuelles historiques du HPSC publiées sur décision de l’exploitant ; l’autorisation écrite de réutilisation n’a pas été confirmée.

sources.label: ECDC Surveillance Atlas — Ireland Annual Baseline
sources.description: Ireland annual Member-State reported case counts from the ECDC Surveillance Atlas. Missing topic/year cells remain unknown and published zeroes are preserved. Data provided by ECDC based on data reported by EU/EEA Member States.

source_info.primary_label: Iceland Directorate of Health Annual Dashboard
source_info.notes: Iceland Directorate of Health annual, monthly STI, weekly respiratory and historical Excel surveillance. Source series retain reporting basis and temporal grain separately.

sources.label: Iceland Directorate of Health Annual Dashboard
sources.description: National annual case notifications by disease. Published values can be revised retrospectively and remain annual period totals.

sources.label: Iceland Directorate of Health STI Dashboard
sources.description: Monthly STI diagnosis facts from laboratory and registry surveillance; the official dashboard is published on a quarterly schedule.

sources.label: Iceland Directorate of Health Respiratory Dashboard
sources.description: ISO-week respiratory diagnosis counts. Hospitalizations, samples, and vaccination indicators are separate measures and are not counted as diagnoses.

sources.label: Iceland Directorate of Health Historical Registry
sources.description: Historical official registry tables for 1997–2021, with annual totals and disease-specific monthly notification facts retained at source grain.

sources.label: Iceland Directorate of Health Legacy ICD Monthly
sources.description: Historical Saga EHR ICD encounter counts for 1997–2020. This clinical measure is non-comparable with registry notifications and is kept separate.

source_info.primary_label: Iceland Directorate of Health Annual Dashboard
source_info.notes: Iceland Directorate of Health annual, monthly STI, weekly respiratory and historical Excel surveillance. Source series retain reporting basis and temporal grain separately.

sources.label: Iceland Directorate of Health Annual Dashboard
sources.description: National annual case notifications by disease. Published values can be revised retrospectively and remain annual period totals.

sources.label: Iceland Directorate of Health STI Dashboard
sources.description: Monthly STI diagnosis facts from laboratory and registry surveillance; the official dashboard is published on a quarterly schedule.

sources.label: Iceland Directorate of Health Respiratory Dashboard
sources.description: ISO-week respiratory diagnosis counts. Hospitalizations, samples, and vaccination indicators are separate measures and are not counted as diagnoses.

sources.label: Iceland Directorate of Health Historical Registry
sources.description: Historical official registry tables for 1997–2021, with annual totals and disease-specific monthly notification facts retained at source grain.

sources.label: Iceland Directorate of Health Legacy ICD Monthly
sources.description: Historical Saga EHR ICD encounter counts for 1997–2020. This clinical measure is non-comparable with registry notifications and is kept separate.
